console.name: jfr-memory-leak
console.title: JFR Memory Leak
console.description: JFR-based old object sampling for memory leak diagnosis

duration.label: query
duration.description: Recording duration in seconds (0 means manual stop)

limit.label: query
limit.description: Limits the number of entries displayed

minSize.label: query
minSize.description: Minimum object size in bytes to include in results

stacktrace.label: query
stacktrace.description: Whether to include stack traces in the output

status.description: The console status: recording, completed, compared, idle, or error

error.description: An error message (only present when status is error)

note.description: An informational note (only present for an idle query)

startTime.description: Epoch time in milliseconds the recording started (only present while recording)

durationSeconds.description: The requested recording duration in seconds (only present when set)

elapsedMs.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds since the recording started (only present while recording)

remainingMs.description: Remaining time in milliseconds until auto-stop (only present when a duration was requested)

hasCachedResults.description: Whether cached results are available (only present for a status query)

hasComparisonData.description: Whether a previous recording is available for comparison (only present for a status query)

sampleCount.description: The number of aggregated samples (only present when results are available)

recordingDurationMs.description: The recording duration in milliseconds (only present when results are available)

recordingEndTime.description: Epoch time in milliseconds the recording ended (only present when results are available)

rawSampleCount.description: The number of raw samples before aggregation (only present when results are available)

gcCount.description: The number of garbage collections observed (only present when results are available)

allocationClass.description: The allocated class name (only present when known)

allocationSize.description: The allocation size in bytes (only present when known)

lastKnownHeapUsage.description: The last known heap usage in bytes (only present when known)

arrayElements.description: The number of array elements (only present for arrays)

objectAge.description: The object age in milliseconds (only present when known)

allocationTime.description: Epoch time in milliseconds when the object was allocated

stackTrace.description: The allocation stack trace (only present when requested)

type.description: The type name (only present when known)

field.description: The field name (only present when known)

description.description: A description of the link (only present when known)

referenceChain.description: The reference chain back to the GC root (only present when there is one)

count.description: The number of samples aggregated into this entry

sampledSize.description: The total sampled size in bytes across the aggregated samples

samples.description: The aggregated samples (only present when results are available)

gcCount.description: The number of garbage collections observed

baseline.description: The baseline recording info (only present for a comparison)

gcCount.description: The number of garbage collections observed

current.description: The current recording info (only present for a comparison)

durationRatio.description: The ratio of the current to the baseline recording duration (only present for a comparison)

baselineSampledSize.description: The baseline sampled size in bytes

currentSampledSize.description: The current sampled size in bytes

growthRatio.description: The growth ratio between baseline and current sampled size

trend.description: The trend: new, gone, growing, suspicious, shrinking, or stable

lowConfidence.description: Whether the comparison has low statistical confidence

type.description: The type name (only present when known)

field.description: The field name (only present when known)

description.description: A description of the link (only present when known)

referenceChain.description: The reference chain back to the GC root (only present when there is one)

stackTrace.description: The allocation stack trace (only present when requested)

comparisons.description: The per-class comparisons, sorted by growth ratio descending (only present for a comparison)
